description: Figure 2 is a bar chart that displays the average accuracy across 11 datasets on the vertical y-axis, with each training method represented by a separate bar along the horizontal x-axis. The chart visually compares the performance of different training methods, including Self-RAG, FactTune, and CING S (with and without context supervision), all evaluated on the Llama 2 base model. The bars are arranged in a single group, with each bar's height corresponding to its average accuracy score. The chart does not show any specific numerical values or tick marks on the axes, nor does it indicate a particular scale or unit for the y-axis beyond "Avg. accuracy". The bars are presented in a standard, unsorted order, with no visual emphasis such as shading or highlighting applied to any particular bar. The chart is described in the accompanying text as showing that CING S consistently outperforms the other methods, achieving an average 5.9% absolute improvement.
